{{Short description|Football tournament group stage}}
The '''2019–20 UEFA Europa League group stage''' began on 19 September and ended on 12 December 2019.<ref name="calendar">{{cite web|url=https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuropaleague/news/024d-0e995882024f-5f10c0b9f2fe-1000--2019-20-europa-league-match-and-draw-calendar/|title=2019/20 Europa League match and draw calendar|website=[[UEFA]]|publisher=Union of European Football Associations|date=14 January 2019}}</ref> A total of 48 teams competed in the group stage to decide 24 of the 32 places in the [[2019–20 UEFA Europa League knockout phase|knockout phase]] of the [[2019–20 UEFA Europa League]].<ref name="regulations">{{cite web|url=https://www.uefa.com/MultimediaFiles/Download/Regulations/uefaorg/Regulations/02/60/88/40/2608840_DOWNLOAD.pdf|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190912201329/https://www.uefa.com/MultimediaFiles/Download/Regulations/uefaorg/Regulations/02/60/88/40/2608840_DOWNLOAD.pdf|url-status=dead|archive-date=September 12, 2019|title=Regulations of the UEFA Europa League 2019/20|website=[[UEFA]]|publisher=Union of European Football Associations}}</ref>

==Draw==
The draw for the group stage was held on 30 August 2019, 13:00 [[Central European Summer Time|CEST]], at the [[Grimaldi Forum]] in Monaco.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuropaleague/draws/2020/2001150/|title=UEFA Europa League group stage draw|website=[[UEFA]]|publisher=Union of European Football Associations}}</ref>

The 48 teams were drawn into twelve groups of four, with the restriction that teams from the same association could not be drawn against each other. For the draw, the teams were seeded into four pots based on their 2019 [[UEFA coefficient#Men's Club coefficient|UEFA club coefficients]].

On 17 July 2014, the UEFA emergency panel ruled that Ukrainian and Russian clubs would not be drawn against each other "until further notice" due to the [[2014 pro-Russian unrest in Ukraine|political unrest]] between the countries.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.uefa.com/news-media/news/0257-0def7bee9b85-aae58bd67de5-1000--emergency-panel-decisions/|title=Emergency Panel decisions|website=[[UEFA]]|publisher=Union of European Football Associations|date=17 July 2014}}</ref>

Moreover, for associations with two or more teams, teams were paired in order to split them into two sets of six groups (A–F, G–L) for maximum television coverage. The following pairings were announced by UEFA after the group stage teams were confirmed:<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuropaleague/news/0254-0e99e13edaac-494fb2043542-1000--europa-league-group-stage-draw-all-you-need-to-know/|title=Europa League group stage draw: all you need to know|website=[[UEFA]]|publisher=Union of European Football Associations|date=29 August 2019}}</ref>

==Format==
In each group, teams played against each other home-and-away in a [[round-robin tournament|round-robin format]]. The group winners and runners-up advanced to the [[2019–20 UEFA Europa League knockout phase|round of 32]], where they were joined by the eight third-placed teams of the [[2019–20 UEFA Champions League group stage|Champions League group stage]].

===Tiebreakers===
Teams were ranked according to [[Points (association football)|points]] (3 points for a win, 1 point for a draw, 0 points for a loss), and if tied on points, the following tiebreaking criteria were applied, in the order given, to determine the rankings (Regulations Articles 16.01):<ref name="regulations"/>
#Points in head-to-head matches among tied teams;
#[[Goal difference]] in head-to-head matches among tied teams;
#Goals scored in head-to-head matches among tied teams;
#[[Away goals rule|Away goals]] scored in head-to-head matches among tied teams;
#If more than two teams were tied, and after applying all head-to-head criteria above, a subset of teams were still tied, all head-to-head criteria above were reapplied exclusively to this subset of teams;
#Goal difference in all group matches;
#Goals scored in all group matches;
#Away goals scored in all group matches;
#Wins in all group matches;
#Away wins in all group matches;
#Disciplinary points (red card = 3 points, yellow card = 1 point, expulsion for two yellow cards in one match = 3 points);
#[[UEFA club coefficient]].

==Groups==
The matchdays were 19 September, 3 October, 24 October, 7 November, 28 November, and 12 December 2019.<ref name="calendar"/> The scheduled kickoff times were 18:55 and 21:00 CET/CEST, with possible exceptions at 16:50 CET/CEST due to geographical reasons.

Times are [[Central European Time|CET]]/[[Central European Summer Time|CEST]],{{refn|group=note|[[Central European Summer Time|CEST]] ([[UTC+02:00|UTC+2]]) for dates up to 26 October 2019 (matchdays 1–3), and [[Central European Time|CET]] ([[UTC+01:00|UTC+1]]) for dates thereafter (matchdays 4–6).}} as listed by UEFA (local times, if different, are in parentheses).
